Sixth pre-release of 2.0 — the **Preview** (KOReader workbench) is in the new Qt interface, so now every area of Bookbench runs in Qt. What is left for 2.0 is cleaning up.

## New

- **Preview / KOReader workbench:** the picture from KOReader on the right. Click left or right to turn pages; on the start screen a click taps there. Ctrl+click taps, right-click long-presses, dragging swipes, the mouse wheel turns pages or scrolls.
- The sub-pages are listed below *Preview* in the sidebar: *Font and margins*, *Sleep screen*, *Patches*, *Bookends*, *Bookshelf*. A dot marks a page with unsaved changes.
- **Bookends:** lines, the selected line (style, size, offset, page filter, bar in the line), progress bars, general settings, presets, special characters. Nerd Font symbols now show directly in the text fields.
- **Bookshelf:** themes, wallpaper, plank, ornaments, colours, the top panel, modules, start menu, shelves, and all keys in the file.
- Take the profile from the e-reader or a backup, *Open in KOReader*, *To the e-reader …*, and its own *Preview* menu.

## Install

- **Linux:** *Help > Check for updates* in an installed copy (with *Settings > Updates > Include pre-releases* on), or `install.sh` from this repository. The preview needs the desktop KOReader.
- **Windows:** `Bookbench_Setup_2.0-beta6.exe` (not signed yet: SmartScreen > *More info* > *Run anyway*). There is no preview on Windows.
